Arkham Updates
Bounties V2 is live!
Introducing multiple submission queuing: Multiple users can now make submissions to a single bounty on the Arkham Intel Exchange.
V1 allowed one user to submit a bounty at a time.
With V2, anyone can submit to any active bounty without waiting for another user’s submission to be processed.
But be fast! Bounties are awarded to the first approvable submission - make sure you submit as soon as you’re ready.
🔗

Webhook alerts are now supported on Arkham!
We’ve added support for webhooks to Arkham alerts, allowing you to receive alerts on any interface of your choice that uses them.
Webhooks send you alert data in JSON format, allowing you to represent it in any way you like - either through platforms which use webhooks, or your own custom tools.

Announcing the Arkham Tracer!
Our latest feature lets you trace fund-flows across wallets & blockchains in a whole new chronological way.
Want to track cross-chain movements of hacked funds, or outflows from a compromised bridge contract?
No problem.
With the Tracer, you can create, edit, and save multistage graphs - allowing you to completely map out fund flows from source to destination.
